registration.statement: An aromatic Fold carrier is one complete generated molecular cycle retaining both Fold boundary fibres and at least one complete layer of their four ordered pair cells. The primitive support count is six; every lawful successor adds the same four-cell layer, forcing ten, fourteen and every later positive successor. Opening the complete recurrence requires one retained positive transfer, so the closed recurrence precedes its opened localized reference without an imported electron-count or measured-energy rule.
registration.title: Exact aromatic recurrence, support sequence and positive stability law
